name: Saag Chicken with Spinach and Spices
steps: Brown the chicken in ghee.
Soften the onion, garlic and ginger with the spices and add the blended spinach.
Return the chicken, stir in the yogurt and simmer 15 minutes.

name: Chana Masala
steps: Soften the onion, garlic and ginger in oil with the spices.
Add the tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer 20 minutes.
Finish with cilantro.

name: Red Lentil Dal with Spinach
steps: Soften the onion, garlic and ginger with the spices in oil.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and broth and simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in the spinach.

name: Tandoori-Style Chicken Thighs with Cucumber Raita
steps: Marinate the chicken in half the yogurt with spices, garlic, ginger and lemon.
Roast at 425°F for 30 minutes.
Stir the rest of the yogurt with grated cucumber and mint.

name: Shrimp Curry with Coconut Milk
steps: Soften the onion, garlic and ginger with the curry powder.
Add the tomatoes and coconut milk and simmer 8 minutes.
Add the shrimp and spinach for 4 minutes; serve over rice.

name: Cauliflower and Potato Curry (Aloo Gobi)
steps: Soften the onion and spices in oil.
Add the cauliflower, potatoes and tomatoes with a splash of water.
Cover and cook 20 minutes; finish with cilantro.

name: Pad Thai with Shirataki Noodles and Shrimp
steps: Rinse the shirataki well.
Sear the shrimp in oil, scramble in the egg.
Add the noodles, sauce of fish sauce, paste and lime, then sprouts.
Top with peanuts and green onion.

name: Thai Green Curry with Chicken and Vegetables
steps: Fry the curry paste, add the coconut milk and simmer.
Add the chicken and vegetables and cook 15 minutes.
Finish with basil and fish sauce and serve over cauliflower rice.

name: Thai Basil Chicken Stir-Fry
steps: Stir-fry the garlic and chicken in oil.
Add the vegetables, soy sauce, fish sauce and chili.
Fold in the basil and serve over rice.

name: Tom Kha Gai-Style Coconut Chicken Soup
steps: Simmer the broth, lemongrass and ginger 10 minutes.
Add the chicken, mushrooms and coconut milk and cook 12 minutes.
Finish with lime, fish sauce and cilantro.

name: Bibimbap-Style Bowls with Egg and Vegetables
steps: Sauté each vegetable separately with a little sesame oil.
Fry the eggs.
Arrange over rice and top with gochujang and sesame seeds.

name: Korean Chicken Thighs with Gochujang Glaze
steps: Mix the gochujang, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic and sesame oil and coat the chicken.
Roast at 425°F for 28 minutes.
Serve with sautéed bok choy and sesame seeds.

name: Japchae-Style Stir-Fried Vegetables with Beef
steps: Rinse the shirataki and stir-fry with the sliced beef.
Add the vegetables and garlic.
Season with soy sauce and sesame oil and top with seeds.

name: Chicken Ramen-Style Noodle Soup with Soy Egg
steps: Simmer the broth with ginger, soy sauce and mushrooms.
Poach the chicken in it, then slice.
Boil the soba and eggs separately.
Assemble bowls with bok choy, egg, chicken and green onion.

name: Chicken Katsu-Style Baked Cutlets with Cabbage
steps: Coat the pounded chicken in egg then almond flour and parmesan and bake on an oiled tray at 425°F for 18 minutes.
Shred the cabbage with vinegar and sesame oil.
Serve with a quick sauce of paste thinned with vinegar.

name: Salmon Sushi Bowls with Cucumber and Avocado
steps: Season the rice with the vinegar.
Top with salmon, cucumber, avocado, shredded nori and sesame seeds.
Serve with soy sauce.

name: Edamame Miso Soup with Spinach
steps: Simmer the broth, edamame and tofu 5 minutes.
Add the spinach.
Whisk in the miso off the heat and top with green onion.

name: Vietnamese Banh Mi Bowls with Pork
steps: Brown the pork with garlic and fish sauce.
Quick-pickle the carrot and daikon in lime.
Serve over rice with cucumber, cilantro and jalapeno.

name: Vietnamese Chicken Pho-Style Soup
steps: Simmer the broth with ginger, onion, star anise and chicken 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken.
Serve over rinsed shirataki with sprouts, basil, lime and jalapeno.

name: Summer Rolls with Shrimp and Peanut Dip
steps: Poach and halve the shrimp.
Wrap with lettuce, cucumber, carrot, mint and cabbage in large leaves.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce and lime into a dip.

name: Lemongrass Pork Meatballs with Lettuce Wraps
steps: Mix the pork with minced lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce and green onion and shape meatballs.
Bake at 400°F for 15 minutes.
Serve in lettuce with mint and cucumber.

name: Spicy Tuna Roll Salad with Cucumber
steps: Mix the tuna with sriracha and yogurt.
Toss the cucumber with vinegar and spoon the tuna on top.
Add avocado, nori and sesame.

name: Sesame Ginger Salmon with Bok Choy
steps: Brush the salmon with soy sauce, ginger, garlic and sesame oil and bake at 400°F for 12 minutes.
Sauté the bok choy and serve with seeds.

name: Hot and Sweet Tofu with Broccoli
steps: Crisp the cubed tofu in oil.
Stir-fry the broccoli and garlic.
Add the sriracha, soy sauce, vinegar and arrowroot slurry and toss.

name: Coconut Shrimp Soup with Zucchini Noodles
steps: Fry the curry paste and add the coconut milk and broth.
Simmer 5 minutes, add the shrimp for 3.
Stir in the zucchini noodles, lime and cilantro.

name: Egg Roll in a Bowl with Ground Chicken
steps: Brown the chicken with garlic and ginger in oil.
Add the slaw mix and soy sauce and cook 6 minutes.
Finish with sesame oil and green onion.
